## Bounded issue and output

State the actual issue, base/head/tree and changed scope. Identify what remains
unfinished; avoid automatic closing keywords for partial work.

## Source and human authority

List exact inspected sources and reading scopes, deltas, author instructions,
agent proposals, affected DGs and their existing human owners. Identify any
applicable human grant without treating this generated template as consent.
State whether any source or asset bytes change. Preserve the original PNG.

## Actual validation

Record commands, environment, input identities, counts, failures, skips and unrun
checks. Link actual logs. Distinguish structural tests, finite mathematical
examples, editorial self-review, independent review and human acceptance.

## Review and resumption

Explain arguments/objections in new prose, pending decisions, eligible next work
and recovery. One work PR; no unattended continuation. G1/G2/G3 remain separate.
